subject: general
question: The Battle of Kannauj was fought between Sher Shah Suri and the Mughals led by _______________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Humayun**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Battle of Kannauj was fought between Sher Shah Suri and the Mughal Emperor **Humayun**.
 
• This battle took place in the year **1540**.
 
• The defeat in this battle led to Humayun's temporary loss of the Mughal throne.
 
• Sher Shah Suri went on to establish the Sur Empire in North India following his victory.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Humayun** was the second emperor of the Mughal Empire, succeeding his father Babur.
 
• After losing to Sher Shah Suri, Humayun went into exile for about 15 years.
 
• He later regained the throne with the help of the Persian Empire in 1555, shortly before his death in 1556.
 
• Sher Shah Suri is known for his administrative reforms and the introduction of the currency system called "Rupiya."
